Account: Saffron Telemetry Systems (fleet telemetry + real-time route optimization). Procurement-stage enterprise; heavy focus on deterministic throughput and tail latency. Main ask: Dedicated capacity with explicit throughput guarantees and a clear burst policy.

Summary of requirements / asks (customer):
- Sustained baseline: minimum committed tokens/sec for inference pool to support real-time reranking + streaming chat for drivers. They want predictable per-minute throughput, not just best-effort.
- Target baseline numbers: customer asked for an initial committed baseline of 30k tokens/sec with ability to scale to 90k tokens/sec during predictable peak windows (e.g., morning dispatch 06:00-09:00).
- Concurrency caps: need support for 1,200 concurrent active sessions (chat streams) and 6k short-lived calls/sec for very short-bodied telemetry prompts.
- Burst policy: want bursts up to 3x baseline for up to 10 minutes without immediate throttling; beyond that, graceful degradation (lower-cost model fallback) is acceptable.
- Latency SLOs: p95 token latency target <= 250ms for streaming generation; p99 <= 600ms. End-to-end response SLO for short reranking calls (<= 512 tokens) is p95 < 350ms.
- Capacity planning: initial reservation: 8x80GB GPUs (A100 class equivalent) dedicated, with option to add 4x as buffer; customer expects predictable perf numbers from that config.
- SLA/penalties: strict credits for missing min-tokens/sec guarantee during business hours; customer pushing for 10% credit for first-hour breaches and escalated credits for multi-hour outages.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized model variants when primary cannot meet latency SLOs; prefer policy-based routing that keeps critical regions on dedicated pool.
- Security & compliance: VPC-only control plane, KMS integration, audit logs retention 3 years, SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning.
